meta.name: 70s Cinema
meta.description:
Hollywood changed forever in the 1970s when the studio system collapsed and renegade filmmakers took over. Now relive the award-winning classics and drive-in theater favorites of the era on Pluto TV’s 70s Cinema.

Shows: The Longest Yard (1974), Grease, Up in Smoke, Escape from Alcatraz, The Warriors
Available on: Pluto TV
